The user wants to find the pair of residues with the most severe steric clash in the provided PDB structure.
A steric clash usually means two non-bonded atoms are too close to each other. I need to calculate distances between all pairs of atoms from different residues, and find the minimum distance. If the distance is less than the sum of van der Waals radii, it's a clash. The "most severe" implies the shortest distance between non-bonded atoms in different residues.
Wait, sometimes "steric clash" just means the shortest distance between any two heavy atoms from different residues that are not directly bonded (or perhaps even including bonded ones if it's a bad clash, but usually it's non-bonded). I will compute all pairwise distances between atoms of different residues.
Since I don't have a built-in calculator, I'll have to look at the coordinates and estimate or calculate distances.
